title: Weekly update 6

sections.heading: Overview
bullets: Discover nine global biomes, plus a hidden phenomenon, by completing rolls during their occurrences.
Explore new native gems and optional biome-exclusive prestige gems.
Browse discovered biome conditions in the Gem Index.
Use biome-neutral Tournament Mode to exclude biome amplification and biome-exclusive gems while keeping eligible personal buffs.
View active biome information in the Gem Index.
Retain the familiar Roll-page layout and navigation.
Improved keyboard focus in mobile sheets.

title: Weekly update 5

sections.heading: Easier navigation
bullets: On phones, use Roll, Inventory, Craft, Shop and More, with grouped search to find every other destination.
On desktop, browse grouped Explore destinations with clearer overflow navigation.
Improved mobile sheets, touch targets and keyboard focus handling.

sections.heading: Mining and events
bullets: The roll card now shows a pickaxe mining a faceted rock, with your actual gem results appearing on impact.
Roll animation settings and reduced-motion preferences are respected.
Active events now appear together in one expandable card with event counts and countdowns.

sections.heading: Season 1 — The Interlude
bullets: Added a scheduled 50-tier Season 1 pass with free and premium rewards, daily and weekly missions, and six exclusive profile cosmetics.
Season 1 runs from 17 October at 08:00 Singapore time to 16 November at 08:00. Unlocked reward claims remain available until 23 November at 08:00.
Season Zero progress and previously earned cosmetics remain available in the archive.

sections.heading: Update history
bullets: Rebuilt the Update Log with dated game updates from the merged PR history, search and older-update browsing.
Weekly releases now have a one-time update popup when you enter the game, with the complete history available through All updates.

sections.heading: Recaps and profiles
bullets: Find both monthly recaps in one place and switch between Month One and Month Two.
Profile links now use usernames, and View profile is available from your account menu.

sections.heading: Dungeon progression
bullets: Dungeon enemy health now follows a smoother, fixed progression curve, with gentler Elite health and defense scaling.
Lucky mutations still help, but combat bonuses no longer let a single jackpot trivialize hundreds of rooms. Raw dropped-gear GP stays intact.
Boosted 73 mid-game Workbench recipes and matching existing crafts without raising their costs.
Workbench now distinguishes raw and combat GP; fights show your attack and health. Saved fights keep their original stats.
